name: HITME
source:
It's Friday night, Nam's looking for someone to beat him. A suicidal act that will save his life when he meets Astra and Dei, two kind boys who will take care of him. 

HITME is a visual novel set on Santiago de Chile. A kind of homoerotic fantasy full of fascinating colors and music. Drink Terremotos and learn to make Empanadas with the handsome couple, Astra and Dei.

[Edited from [url=https://xiri.itch.io/hitme]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
周五晚上，南正在寻找能打败他的人。当他遇到阿斯特拉和德伊这两个愿意照顾他的善良男孩时，他的自杀行为挽救了他的生命。

HITME是一部以智利圣地亚哥为背景的视觉小说。一种充满迷人色彩和音乐的同性幻想。与英俊的情侣Astra和Dei一起喝Terremotos并学习制作肉馅卷饼。

[编辑自[url=https://xiri.itch.io/hitme]itch.io[/url]]
